snippet.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 - Kickstarter Trailer!!
snippet.description:
Lawn Mowing Simulator 2's Kickstarter is now live!!

Skyhook Games' Managing Director, David & Game Director, Rick are here to tell you about LMS2 and why we've chosen to run a Kickstarter campaign!

Check out the campaign now!
